First decide what kind of task it is, then review it by the matching standard: - Engineering work such as writing code, changing configuration or handling files: check the actual files and output, and find errors, omissions or things not done. - Writing such as fiction, articles or copy: besides whether it meets the request, focus on whether it reads like real people talk — natural and smooth, true to the character and the scene; look for translationese, AI-sounding phrasing, clichés and filler, piled-up adjectives, stiff formal wording and contradictions.
